author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam is astounded by the beauty of this disassembled mechanical wristwatch by Fredrik Ellertsen, the culmination of two and a half years of painstaking experimentation. Fredrik has suspended each of this watch's movements in clear resin with .7mm fishing wire, bringing an exploded diagram into physical form. 

Read Fredrik's journey with this build here: https://fellerts.no/projects/epoch.html

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
